dogecoin.text: If you panic sold your $doge because of SNL. You should not have been holding doge to begin with.

Some tuned into SNL to hear about Dogecoin.  Others for Elon.  At the end of the day, last nights episode was a mess. There was nothing funny about the scripts prepared for last night. Elon killed it, but the rest of the cast needed to do better. #ElonSNL #SNLLive
